title: Storage Options and Endogenous Commodity Prices in Continuous Time
abstract: arXiv:2609.29700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the price formation of a storable commodity when the decision to sell or keep the commodity is treated as an embedded storage option. The price process is not imposed exogenously. Instead, a candidate price function determines the demand dynamics, while the optimal stopping value generated by those dynamics produces a new price function. We call a fixed point of this feedback mechanism an endogenous storage-option equilibrium (ESOE), using a separate acronym to distinguish the continuous-time construction studied here from the stationary rational expectations equilibrium terminology of the classical competitive-storage literature. A global existence result is established on a compact admissible class under a transparent drift--discount condition. translated_title: 连续时间中的存储期权与内生商品价格
translated_abstract: 我们研究了可储存商品的价格形成问题，其中出售或保留商品的决策被视为一种内嵌的存储期权。价格过程并非外生给定；相反，一个候选价格函数决定需求的动态，而由这些动态产生的最优停时价值又生成一个新的价格函数。我们将这一反馈机制的不动点称为内生存储期权均衡（ESOE），并使用单独的缩写以区别于经典竞争性存储文献中稳态理性预期均衡的术语。在一个紧的可容许类上，于一个清晰的漂移—贴现条件下，我们建立了全局存在性结果。该论证避免了逐区间扩展局部不动点的做法，也不依据Schauder定理宣称唯一性。随后，我们将均衡刻画为一个非线性最优化问题……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将可储存商品的出售或保留决策建模为内嵌存储期权，通过候选价格函数与需求动态之间的反馈不动点定义了连续时间下的内生存储期权均衡（ESOE），并在清晰的漂移—贴现条件下证明了均衡的全局存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper models the sell-or-hold decision for a storable commodity as an embedded storage option, defines an endogenous storage-option equilibrium (ESOE) as the fixed point of the feedback between a candidate price function and demand dynamics in continuous time, and establishes global existence under a transparent drift-discount condition.
